title: GoHighLevel (GHL) & Meta Ads Setup Specialist for Corporate AI Training Company
systemName: Your Meta to GoHighLevel lead system

facts: Dubai-based corporate AI training company; audience HR, L&D and senior management.
Landing page HTML, Meta creatives and copy already prepared; strictly technical implementation.

Scope: GHL landing pages, forms, pipelines, tagging, lead source tracking, email follow-up from provided content, notifications, appointment booking; Meta campaigns, Pixel, CAPI, UTMs, lead forms into GHL; testing and reporting on leads, cost per lead and conversions.
No Meta Ads adapter: Meta is shown only through the GHL Facebook lead trigger and source fields on GHL records.

metrics.name: Cost per lead
metrics.definition: Meta spend for a campaign divided by the leads GoHighLevel recorded from that campaign over the same dates, using the UTM campaign on each contact.

metrics.name: Leads that book a discovery call
metrics.aim: Book more calls from the same leads
metrics.definition: Contacts with a booked discovery call divided by all new Meta leads in the same period, counting each contact once, shown per campaign.

metrics.name: Leads with full source data
metrics.aim: Keep the source on every lead
metrics.definition: Share of new contacts that carry the Meta campaign, form and UTM values, checked weekly so reporting matches what Meta Ads Manager shows.
